title: 通告中的條件
Conditions in a notice
question: 通告寫：‘Bring a signed form by Friday. Students without a form may watch but cannot climb.’ Mei 沒有表格。她可以怎樣？
A notice says: ‘Bring a signed form by Friday. Students without a form may watch but cannot climb.’ Mei has no form. What may she do?
options: 觀看活動，但不能攀爬。
Watch the activity, but not climb.
‘may watch’ 與 ‘cannot climb’ 分別說明許可和限制。
‘May watch’ gives permission; ‘cannot climb’ sets a limit.
只要帶運動鞋便可以攀爬。
Climb if she brings trainers.
通告沒有以運動鞋代替表格的規定。
The notice does not allow trainers to replace the form.
不能進入活動場地。
Stay away from the activity entirely.
‘may watch’ 明確容許觀看。
‘May watch’ explicitly permits attendance as an observer.
takeaway: 閱讀通告時同時找出許可、限制和所需條件。
Read permissions, restrictions and required conditions together.

title: 清楚的問路請求
A clear request for directions
question: 你第一次到校，要禮貌地向職員詢問圖書館位置。哪句最合適？
On your first school visit, you politely ask a staff member where the library is. Which sentence fits best?
options: Could you tell me where the library is, please?
Could you tell me where the library is, please?
這句交代清楚需要，間接問句使用 ‘where the library is’。
This is a clear polite request; the indirect question uses ‘where the library is’.
Could you tell me where is the library, please?
Could you tell me where is the library, please?
間接問句的主語 ‘the library’ 應在動詞 ‘is’ 前。
In an indirect question, the subject ‘the library’ comes before ‘is’.
You know the library, don't you?
You know the library, don't you?
這句只問對方是否知道圖書館，沒有清楚詢問位置。
This asks whether the person knows the library, rather than clearly requesting its location.
takeaway: 請求要符合對象和目的；禮貌詞並不能代替清楚句意。
Match a request to its audience and purpose; politeness also needs clarity.

title: 從行動推斷感受
Inferring feelings from actions
question: 讀原創句子：‘Before her turn, Asha checked her notes three times. When her name was called, she took a deep breath and walked to the front.’ 哪項推斷最有支持？
Read this original passage: ‘Before her turn, Asha checked her notes three times. When her name was called, she took a deep breath and walked to the front.’ Which inference is best supported?
options: 她有點緊張，但仍準備發言。
She feels nervous but is prepared to speak.
重複查看筆記及深呼吸支持緊張；走到前面顯示她仍參與。
Repeated checking and a deep breath suggest nerves; walking forward shows participation.
她對題目完全沒有準備。
She has done no preparation at all.
筆記是準備的線索，不能從緊張推斷完全未準備。
Her notes are evidence of preparation; nerves do not prove she is unprepared.
她肯定會得到全班最高分。
She will certainly receive the highest mark.
段落沒有交代表現或評分，不能推斷結果。
The passage gives no performance or assessment evidence.
takeaway: 推論必須連結文本細節，並保留未能確定的部分。
Link an inference to textual details and leave uncertain outcomes open.

title: 先後發生的事件
Ordering past events
question: ‘By the time the rehearsal began, Jo ___ the sound equipment.’ 文意是 Jo 先檢查器材，綵排才開始。應填哪項？
‘By the time the rehearsal began, Jo ___ the sound equipment.’ Jo checked the equipment before the rehearsal started. Which form fits?
options: had checked
had checked
過去完成式表達另一過去事件之前已完成的動作。
The past perfect marks completion before another past event.
will check
will check
將來式不符合兩件事均已在過去發生的時間線。
The future form does not fit two events located in the past.
has checked
has checked
現在完成式通常連結現在；此句以過去的綵排作參照。
The present perfect links to the present, but the reference point here is a past rehearsal.
takeaway: 選擇時態前，先確定事件的參照時間和先後。
Identify the reference time and event order before choosing a tense.

title: 連接相反觀點
Linking contrasting ideas
question: 要連接 ‘The route is longer’ 和 ‘It has fewer stairs’，並建議輪椅使用者考慮這條路。哪句最清楚保留兩點？
Link ‘The route is longer’ and ‘It has fewer stairs’ when suggesting a route for a wheelchair user to consider. Which sentence keeps both points clearly?
options: Although the route is longer, it has fewer stairs.
Although the route is longer, it has fewer stairs.
‘Although’ 表示距離與樓梯數目的取捨；仍需核對路線是否完全無梯級。
‘Although’ shows the trade-off; the route still needs checking for step-free access.
The route is longer because it has fewer stairs.
The route is longer because it has fewer stairs.
原有資料沒有證明樓梯較少是路程較長的原因。
The given information does not establish that fewer stairs cause the longer route.
The route has fewer stairs, so its distance is shorter.
The route has fewer stairs, so its distance is shorter.
這句把 ‘longer’ 的原意改成 ‘shorter’。
This changes the original meaning from ‘longer’ to ‘shorter’.
takeaway: 連接詞應表達材料真正支持的關係，而非額外製造因果。
Use a connective that matches the supported relationship, without inventing causation.

title: 代詞與論點連貫
Reference and coherence
question: ‘The council suggested planting trees beside the court. It also recommended shaded seats. These measures would give students cooler places to rest.’ ‘These measures’ 指甚麼？
‘The council suggested planting trees beside the court. It also recommended shaded seats. These measures would give students cooler places to rest.’ What does ‘These measures’ refer to?
options: 種樹和設置有遮蔭的座位。
Planting trees and providing shaded seats.
複數短語總結前兩句的兩項建議。
The plural phrase summarises the two proposals in the preceding sentences.
只指學生會本身。
Only the council itself.
學生會是提出建議的組織，不是兩項措施。
The council proposes the measures; it is not itself the measures.
只指測量球場溫度。
Only measuring the court temperature.
‘measures’ 在此指措施；段落沒有提及測量。
Here ‘measures’ means actions, and no temperature measurement is mentioned.
takeaway: 利用上下文與單複數線索辨認指涉，避免只按單字常見意思理解。
Use context and number agreement to resolve reference, rather than one familiar word meaning.

title: 報告中的被動語態
Passive voice in a report
question: 報告重點是匿名問卷，而非派發者：‘Two hundred anonymous questionnaires ___ to students last Monday.’ 哪項正確？
A report focuses on anonymous questionnaires rather than who distributed them: ‘Two hundred anonymous questionnaires ___ to students last Monday.’ Which form is correct?
options: were distributed
were distributed
複數問卷是接受動作的對象，‘last Monday’ 要求過去式。
The plural questionnaires receive the action, and ‘last Monday’ locates it in the past.
distributed
distributed
這會令問卷變成主動派發東西的主語，句意不成立。
This makes the questionnaires perform the distribution, which does not fit the meaning.
are distributing
are distributing
現在進行式主動語態既不符合時間，也不符合動作關係。
The present progressive active form fits neither the time nor who receives the action.
takeaway: 語態要配合誰做動作、誰接受動作，以及報告焦點。
Choose voice by the action roles and the report's focus.

title: 撮要保留限制條件
Summarising with conditions
question: ‘The pilot reading club attracted 24 students. Most attended regularly, but interviews were conducted only with six volunteers.’ 哪句撮要最準確？
‘The pilot reading club attracted 24 students. Most attended regularly, but interviews were conducted only with six volunteers.’ Which summary is most accurate?
options: 出席大致穩定，但訪談只涵蓋六名自願者。
Attendance was generally regular, but interviews covered only six volunteers.
這句保留正面觀察及資料範圍。
This retains both the positive observation and the evidence boundary.
所有參加者均接受訪問並支持計劃。
All participants were interviewed and supported the programme.
只有六名自願者受訪；原文也沒有交代他們的評價。
Only six volunteers were interviewed, and their opinions are not stated.
只有六名學生參加閱讀會。
Only six students joined the reading club.
六人是受訪數目，參加人數是二十四。
Six is the interview sample; twenty-four is the participation count.
takeaway: 撮要要壓縮字數，不能把樣本數、參與數和結論混為一談。
A summary reduces length without merging sample size, participation and conclusions.

title: 按讀者需要修訂
Revising for an audience
question: 校報給新生的句子是：‘Utilisation of the equipment-lending facility necessitates prior registration.’ 哪個版本最清楚而不改變要求？
A newsletter for new students says: ‘Utilisation of the equipment-lending facility necessitates prior registration.’ Which revision is clearest without changing the requirement?
options: Register before you borrow equipment.
Register before you borrow equipment.
直接動詞清楚交代所需步驟與次序。
Direct verbs clearly communicate the action and its order.
You might register after borrowing equipment.
You might register after borrowing equipment.
‘might’ 和 ‘after’ 把必須事先登記的要求改了。
‘Might’ and ‘after’ change the requirement to register first.
The facility is available to everyone without registration.
The facility is available to everyone without registration.
這句刪去原文的必要條件。
This removes the required condition.
takeaway: 簡明英語應減少閱讀負擔，同時保留原有條件。
Plain English reduces reading effort while preserving conditions.

title: 假設與現實
Hypothetical situations
question: 學校目前沒有空置課室。‘If the school had a spare room, we ___ a quiet study area.’ 哪項最適合這個假設？
The school currently has no spare classroom. ‘If the school had a spare room, we ___ a quiet study area.’ Which form fits this hypothetical situation?
options: could create
could create
‘If ... had’ 配合 ‘could create’，表達與目前情況不同的可能安排。
‘If ... had’ with ‘could create’ expresses a possibility under a different present situation.
had created
had created
這是過去完成式，並不構成此句的假設結果。
The past perfect does not express the hypothetical result needed here.
create yesterday
create yesterday
動詞形式及 ‘yesterday’ 都與目前假設不符。
Both the verb form and ‘yesterday’ conflict with the present hypothetical situation.
takeaway: 條件句的形式反映時間與現實程度，不只是固定詞語配對。
Conditional forms reflect time and reality, not just memorised word pairs.

title: 比較兩項建議
Comparing proposals
question: Proposal A: 40 extra seats, costs $80,000, removes a garden. Proposal B: 25 extra seats, costs $30,000, keeps the garden. 文章要比較成本及環境取捨。哪句最有用？
Proposal A adds 40 seats for $80,000 but removes a garden. Proposal B adds 25 seats for $30,000 and keeps it. Which sentence best compares cost and environmental trade-offs?
options: B 增加的座位較少，但費用較低且保留花園。
B provides fewer extra seats, but costs less and preserves the garden.
這句同時交代兩方案在數量、費用與環境上的差異。
This compares capacity, cost and the environmental difference.
B 的座位最多，而且不用花費。
B provides the most seats at no cost.
B 的座位較少，且費用是三萬元。
B adds fewer seats and still costs $30,000.
A 的費用較高，因此所有人都反對。
A costs more, so everyone opposes it.
費用資料不能證明所有人的態度。
Cost figures cannot establish everyone's opinion.
takeaway: 比較段落應使用相同準則，避免把數據改寫成未有證據的民意。
Compare options using common criteria without inventing public opinion.

title: 辨認語氣與含意
Tone and implied criticism
question: 原創評論寫：‘How considerate: the consultation on student wellbeing was held while every class was sitting an examination.’ 作者最可能表達甚麼？
An original commentary says: ‘How considerate: the consultation on student wellbeing was held while every class was sitting an examination.’ What is the writer most likely expressing?
options: 諷刺安排妨礙學生參與。
Irony about scheduling that prevents student participation.
表面的讚賞與無法出席的情境形成反差。
The apparent praise conflicts with the situation that prevents attendance.
真心讚賞考試能改善所有人的身心健康。
Sincere praise that exams improve everyone's wellbeing.
句子批評的是諮詢時間；沒有證明考試的健康效果。
The contrast concerns consultation timing, not evidence of exam benefits.
主張永久取消所有諮詢活動。
A demand to end all consultations permanently.
批評一次安排不等於要求取消整類活動。
Criticising one arrangement does not imply ending all consultations.
takeaway: 語氣可由字面意思與情境的反差表達；推論仍須限制範圍。
Tone can arise from a contrast between literal words and context; keep the inference proportionate.

title: 限定證據能支持的說法
Calibrating a claim
question: A voluntary survey found that 36 of 50 respondents preferred later library hours. 哪句報告最符合證據？
A voluntary survey found that 36 of 50 respondents preferred later library hours. Which report sentence matches the evidence?
options: Most respondents preferred later hours; the voluntary sample may not represent the whole school.
Most respondents preferred later hours; the voluntary sample may not represent the whole school.
‘respondents’ 界定資料範圍；後半句交代抽樣限制。
‘Respondents’ defines the evidence scope; the second clause states the sampling limitation.
Exactly 72% of all students demand later hours.
Exactly 72% of all students demand later hours.
72% 是受訪者比例，不能直接推廣到全校；‘demand’ 也加強了原意。
72% describes respondents, not necessarily the whole school; ‘demand’ also overstates preference.
The survey proves later hours improve examination results.
The survey proves later hours improve examination results.
調查只量度偏好，沒有量度成績或因果關係。
The survey measures preference, not attainment or causation.
takeaway: 用詞強度、母體範圍和研究量度必須一致。
Match the strength and population scope of a claim to what was measured.

title: 有效回應反對意見
Responding to a counterargument
question: 你主張延長圖書館開放時間。反對者指出職員工時限制。哪句最能推進討論？
You propose extending library hours. An objection concerns staff working hours. Which response advances the discussion most effectively?
options: A limited trial on one afternoon, with agreed staffing and a review, could test feasibility.
A limited trial on one afternoon, with agreed staffing and a review, could test feasibility.
這句承認限制，提出可檢驗且具體的調整。
This acknowledges the constraint and offers a specific, testable adjustment.
Anyone who mentions staffing dislikes reading.
Anyone who mentions staffing dislikes reading.
這是批評提出意見的人，沒有處理工時問題。
This attacks people rather than addressing staff time.
Students want it, so staff capacity is irrelevant.
Students want it, so staff capacity is irrelevant.
需求並不使實際資源限制消失。
Demand does not remove a practical resource constraint.
takeaway: 有力的反駁要回應對方最相關的理由，並提供可行證據或調整。
A strong response addresses the relevant objection with evidence or a feasible adjustment.

title: 綜合看似矛盾的資料
Synthesising apparently conflicting evidence
question: Report A says printed-book loans fell by 10%. Report B says total reading sessions rose by 15%, including e-books. 哪項綜合最合理？
Report A says printed-book loans fell by 10%. Report B says total reading sessions rose by 15%, including e-books. Which synthesis is most reasonable?
options: 兩份報告可同時成立，因為量度的範圍不同。
Both reports may be consistent because they measure different categories.
紙本借閱與包含電子書的總閱讀節次不是同一指標。
Printed loans and total sessions including e-books are different indicators.
兩個百分比相加，證明紙本借閱增加 5%。
Adding the percentages proves printed loans rose by 5%.
不同指標的變幅不能直接相加當成紙本變幅。
Changes in different indicators cannot be added to obtain a printed-loan change.
百分比一升一跌，所以必有一份報告造假。
One percentage rises and the other falls, so one report must be fabricated.
不同範圍可以呈相反走勢，並不構成造假的證據。
Different categories can move in different directions without fabrication.
takeaway: 綜合資料前先比較定義、時間與範圍，不能只比較數字方向。
Compare definitions, periods and scope before synthesising numerical findings.

title: 修正懸垂修飾語
Repairing a dangling modifier
question: 背景：委員會審核申請並發現錯誤。草稿寫 ‘After reviewing the applications, several errors were found.’ 哪個版本修正動作主語不清的問題，並保留先後意思？

Context: a committee reviewed applications and found errors. A draft says: ‘After reviewing the applications, several errors were found.’ Which revision fixes the unclear action subject and preserves the sequence?
options: After reviewing the applications, the committee found several errors.
After reviewing the applications, the committee found several errors.
主語 ‘the committee’ 同時負責 reviewing 及 found，動作關係清楚。
‘The committee’ performs both reviewing and finding, so the action roles are clear.
After reviewing the applications, several errors were found by the committee.
After reviewing the applications, several errors were found by the committee.
句首 reviewing 的動作主語仍接到主句的 errors；被動句末加委員會並未修正懸垂關係。
The introductory reviewing phrase still attaches to the main-clause subject errors; adding the committee in a by-phrase does not fix the dangling attachment.
Before reviewing the applications, the committee found several errors.
Before reviewing the applications, the committee found several errors.
主語清楚，但 before 把原文先審核後發現的順序改了。
The subject is clear, but before reverses the original sequence of reviewing and then finding errors.
takeaway: 句首分詞結構應能與主句主語建立合理的動作關係。
An introductory participial phrase should logically attach to the main-clause subject.

title: 區分概述與批判綜合
Critical synthesis across sources
question: Source A reports faster homework feedback with AI. Source B reports missed errors in culturally specific writing. 你要寫建議段落，哪句最能綜合兩者？
Source A reports faster homework feedback with AI. Source B reports missed errors in culturally specific writing. Which recommendation best synthesises both?
options: Use AI for initial feedback, with human review of meaning and cultural context; speed alone is insufficient.
Use AI for initial feedback, with human review of meaning and cultural context; speed alone is insufficient.
建議保留效率優點，同時以覆核回應文化語境的限制。
The recommendation retains the efficiency benefit while addressing contextual errors through review.
Faster feedback means every cultural interpretation is accurate.
Faster feedback means every cultural interpretation is accurate.
速度與語境準確度是不同面向，不能互相證明。
Speed and contextual accuracy are different dimensions; one does not prove the other.
Because some errors occur, neither source contains useful information.
Because some errors occur, neither source contains useful information.
有限制的證據仍可用來設計有條件的建議。
Limited evidence can still inform a qualified recommendation.
takeaway: 批判綜合要把不同證據轉成有條件、可解釋的立場。
Critical synthesis turns different evidence into a qualified, explainable position.

title: 評估因果主張的論據
Evaluating a causal argument
question: An editorial claims a new study app caused higher exam scores. Its only evidence is that app users scored higher than non-users. 哪項補充資料最直接削弱其因果推論？
An editorial claims a new study app caused higher exam scores. Its only evidence is that users scored higher than non-users. Which additional finding most directly weakens the causal inference?
options: 使用者在下載程式之前已取得較高成績。
Users already had higher scores before downloading the app.
起點差異提供另一解釋，削弱把後來差距全歸因於程式的說法。
A prior difference supplies an alternative explanation for the later gap.
程式可在兩種手機系統使用。
The app runs on two phone operating systems.
系統相容性本身不解釋兩組成績差異。
Compatibility alone does not explain the groups' score difference.
文章用了三段文字描述介面。
The editorial spends three paragraphs describing the interface.
篇幅安排不直接檢驗學習效果的因果主張。
Article structure does not directly test the claimed causal effect.
takeaway: 評論因果論證時，要找基線、選擇偏差及可能的替代解釋。
Evaluate causal arguments through baseline differences, selection and alternative explanations.
